stemBlocks: A water trough has the shape of a prism, with a cross section that is a right-angled isosceles triangle. One rectangular face and the two triangular ends of the trough are vertical, as shown. The trough contains water of depth $0.60 \text{ m}$ measured on the vertical rectangular face.
What is the force exerted by the water on one triangular end of the trough? (density of water = $1000 \text{ kg m}^{-3}$; gravitational field strength = $10 \text{ N kg}^{-1}$)
